mentions.name: SetPDF
mentions.description: A small web app that lets musicians add PDF files locally and offline, arrange them, and download the result for use on an e-reader during performances. Designed to work on very old Android devices.
mentions.problem: Musicians need a way to prepare and arrange performance PDFs offline on old devices, without relying on online tools.
mentions.audience: Musicians preparing PDFs for live performance; originally built for a classical musician who uses very old Android devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: Small webapp that allows musicians to add PDFs locally and offline, arrange them, then download for use on an e-reader during performances. Built for a classical musician friend who uses really old Android devices, also my first almost entirely 'vibe-coded' app.

evidence.value: Small webapp that allows musicians to add PDFs locally and offline, arrange them, then download for use on an e-reader during performances. Built for a classical musician friend who uses really old Android devices, also my first almost entirely 'vibe-coded' app.
